# Getting help

- Read the [Windows quickstart](../docs/quickstart.md) and [installation guide](../docs/personal-installation-and-troubleshooting.md).
- Ask a usage question in [Discussions](https://github.com/Huzaifa-Shahid-6ll/robotics-workbench/discussions).
- Use [Issues](https://github.com/Huzaifa-Shahid-6ll/robotics-workbench/issues/new/choose) for a reproducible defect or scoped feature request.
- Report vulnerabilities through [private security reporting](https://github.com/Huzaifa-Shahid-6ll/robotics-workbench/security/advisories/new).
